insurer: Raheja QBE General Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Basic & Super Saver & A la Carte: 1% of SI per day. Comprehensive plan (₹3L–₹50L): No limit. Sub-limit waiver optional add-on available for other plans. For ₹20L+ SI, sub-limits on room are absent in base coverage.

icu.note: Basic, Super Saver, A la Carte: 2% of SI per day. Comprehensive plan: No limit. Proportionate deductions not applicable for ICU charges.

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-pay for insured persons whose entry age is 60 years and above. Super Saver plan has inbuilt 20% co-pay for all ages/insured persons. Voluntary 20% co-pay optional add-on available. Section L (Advance Treatment) has 50% co-pay.

sub_limits.display: Cataract ₹50k/eye, Joint replacement ₹3L/joint, Mental health ₹50k; Doctor fees 25% of SI/claim
sub_limits.note: Cataract (incl. lens) ₹50,000/eye; Joint replacement (incl. implants) ₹3,00,000/joint; Schizophrenia/OCD/Psychosis ₹50,000 each; Doctor/Medical Practitioner fees 25% of SI per claim (Basic, Super Saver, A la Carte). Comprehensive plan and ₹20L+ SI: no room/ICU/doctor sub-limits. Sub-limit waiver optional add-on for eligible plans.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible in base plan. Voluntary co-pay option available as add-on.

initial_waiting.note: First 30 days waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 36 months of continuous coverage. Reduced by prior continuous coverage under portability.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month waiting for cataract, hernia, calculus diseases, GERD, varicose veins, joint replacement, ENT surgeries, etc. 36-month waiting for Schizophrenia, Psychosis, Dissociative disorders.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses (childbirth, C-section, miscarriage) are excluded under Section 5.15 (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: NCB accrues at 5% of SI per claim-free year, up to 100% of original SI. Alternatively, 1% discount on renewal premium. NCB reduced at same rate if claims made in two consecutive years (above ₹50k or 10% of SI threshold).

restoration.note: Recharge/Replenish benefit reinstates full original SI once per policy year if SI exhausted. Recharged SI cannot be used for same illness/injury already claimed in that year. Cannot be carried forward.

pre_hosp.note: Basic: 30 days (₹1-2L), 60 days (₹3-50L). Comprehensive: 60 days. Super Saver: 30 days. A la Carte: 60 days (₹1-2L), 30 days (₹3-50L).

post_hosp.note: Basic: 60 days (₹1-2L), 90 days (₹3-50L). Comprehensive: 90 days. Super Saver: 90 days. A la Carte: 60 days (₹1-2L), 90 days (₹3-50L).

day_care.display: All day-care (indicative list in Annexure II)
day_care.note: Day care procedures covered; Annexure II provides an indicative list of 157+ procedures.

domiciliary.note: Covered under Section J up to ₹15,000–₹1,50,000 depending on SI band. Treatment must continue for more than 3 consecutive days. Several conditions excluded (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, etc.).

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered under inpatient/day care provisions; AYUSH Hospital and Day Care Centre definitions included. No separate sub-limit stated.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor harvesting expenses covered up to 20% of SI (Basic, Super Saver, A la Carte). Not available under Comprehensive plan per schedule. Pre/post hospitalisation of donor not covered.

ambulance.note: ₹1,000 for SI ₹1-2L; ₹1,500 for SI ₹3-9L; ₹2,500 for SI ₹10-50L. Covers home-to-hospital and inter-hospital transfers in emergency.

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern/advance treatments (robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, intravitreal injections, stem cell therapy, etc.) covered under Section L with mandatory 50% co-payment.

consumables.note: Section H covers non-medical/consumable expenses up to ₹1,000–₹5,000/day (SI-based) but only on cashless claims at network providers. Available inbuilt in Comprehensive and Super Saver plans; not available in Basic/A la Carte base.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers only medical treatment within India (Section 8.2). OPD treatment outside India also excluded.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium payment mode and 30 days for all other modes.

free_look.note: 30-day free look period from date of receipt of policy at inception only; not applicable on renewals or portability.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI norms. Apply at least 45 days before but not earlier than 60 days from premium due date.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, OPD (unless rider), treatment outside India, dental (unless accident+24hr hosp), refractive error <7.5D, domiciliary for diabetes/asthma/hypertension etc.

optional_riders.display: Sub-limit waiver, Voluntary 20% co-pay, Home care treatment, OPD rider
